speaker: Doctor
text:
I see you're experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. To better understand your condition, can you tell me if you have noticed any changes in your appetite or recent infections?

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC), Liver Function Tests (LFTs), Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR).

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: COMPLETE BLOOD COUNT (CBC): WBC - Elevated, Hemoglobin - Slightly Decreased, Platelets - Normal; LIVER FUNCTION TESTS (LFTs): NORMAL READINGS; ERYTHROCYTE SEDIMENTATION RATE (ESR): NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text: The blood results show leukocytosis with normal inflammatory markers, which is unusual for typical infections. Given your weight loss and night sweats, could you describe any skin changes, such as rashes or ulcers, or if you have a history of autoimmune conditions?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.
